name: Linear
description: Four chapters progress sequentially, all adhering to Theme A.
instructions: Contains ONLY 4 nodes and 3 edges in total.

name: Divergence
description: Begins with Theme A and continues for two chapters. It then diverges, with one path retaining Theme A and the other shifting to Theme B.
instructions: Contains ONLY 4 nodes and 4 edges in total.

name: Convergence
description: Starts with two chapters: one from Theme A and another from Theme B. Both converge to follow Theme A for the subsequent chapters.
instructions: Contains ONLY 4 nodes and 4 edges in total.

name: Diamond
description: Begins and concludes with Theme A. In between, it branches into two paths: one following Theme B and the other Theme C.
instructions: Contains ONLY 5 nodes and 4 edges in total.

name: Hanger
description: Starts with Theme A and diverges into two paths. One continues with Theme A, while the other explores Theme B, both eventually converging back to Theme A.
instructions: Contains ONLY 4 nodes and 4 edges in total.

name: Parallelogram
description: Starts with Theme A and branches into two paths. One remains with Theme A and concludes with Theme B, while the other directly shifts to Theme B and stays with it.
instructions: Contains ONLY 4 nodes and 4 edges in total.

name: ComplexCombined
description: A combination of SimpleFork, SimpleWideMerge, and SimpleSharpBranch.
instructions: Contains 7 nodes and 6 edges in total.
